subject: Realtime feed: intermittent chunk stalls causing elevated latency and 101/504 timeouts
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@vectorlytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@vectorlytics.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Realtime feed - frequent 101/504s and long tail latency

Evelyn,

We started seeing a spike in realtime session errors around 08:40 PDT this morning: multiple clients reporting 101s and 504s during chunked responses. Latency for streaming completion jumped from ~200ms per chunk to multiple-second gaps; some sessions stalled for >15s before recovering. This is now impacting our user-facing chat UI.

Attached are an app-side trace and a short HAR of a failing session. Can your team confirm whether this looks like a server-side chunking issue or something in the proxy layer?

Appreciate a quick triage — we may need an SLO credit if this persists.

Thanks,
Aisha
Senior Platform Engineer
Vectorlytics
[Attachment: trace-20280522-14.log (text/plain)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@vectorlytics.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime feed - frequent 101/504s and long tail latency

Aisha —

Thanks for the report and the traces. I’ve looped in David and Marissa from Engineering to triage immediately. Initial ask: can you confirm whether the issue is observed across regions or only in us-west-2? Also, do you have a session id we can target for packet capture correlation?

We’ll prioritize this and post updates in this thread.

Evelyn
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proxy_harvest-20280522.json (application/json)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime feed - frequent 101/504s and long tail latency

Team —

I pulled the traces. Two observations so far: 1) there are repeated small MTU-like retransmissions visible in the packet capture around the time the client reports the stall; 2) server-side logs show chunk flushes occurred on schedule, but the proxy ACKs were delayed by ~2–10s for affected sessions. That pattern suggests an intermittent proxy backpressure or TLS record coalescing issue rather than model runtime stalls.

Action items I’m kicking off:
- Marissa, please start a narrow capture of the proxy pool serving Vectorlytics for the us-west-2 AZ during the next hour.
- Jonas, please validate whether any kernel/TCP tuning changes were rolled out yesterday to the affected pool.

I’m marking this high priority.

-David
VP, Infra Engineering
[Attachment: packet_capture-80522.pcap (pcap)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime feed - frequent 101/504s and long tail latency

David —

I started capturing from the proxy pool. Early snapshot shows elevated egress queue lengths on proxy-node-12 and two TLS worker restarts during the 08:38–08:42 window. Rolling restart history shows a small deploy at 02:00 UTC yesterday that touched the NGINX sidecar config (keepalive/tuning).

Temporary mitigation I applied: scaled proxy pool + bumped keepalive timeout to 90s for the Vectorlytics routing tag. That reduced 101s in our synthetic checks from ~12/min to ~3/min. Still seeing some 2–5s chunk gaps in production traffic.

Will continue to monitor and share logs.

-Marissa
Senior SRE
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: aisha.khan@vectorlytics.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime feed - frequent 101/504s and long tail latency

Quick update: I confirmed a config drift in the canary proxy group where tcp_nodelay was unintentionally disabled during the 02:00 UTC change. That explains the batching/coalescing behavior and delayed ACKs. I’ve pushed a rollback for that parameter and restarted the canary proxies.

Evelyn, given Vectorlytics is in contract renewal in Q3 (VL-2028-Q2-11), recommend we offer a goodwill credit if we see more than one more incident in the next 30 days. Also suggest a short postmortem and a plan to harden proxy config rollout (feature flag + extra canary smoke).

-Jonas
Principal Network Engineer

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@vectorlytics.com>, Samir Patel <samir@vectorlytics.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime feed - frequent 101/504s and long tail latency

Aisha / Samir —

Thanks for your patience while we investigated. Root cause: a canary proxy config rollout accidentally disabled tcp_nodelay in a subset of edges, which allowed TLS/TCP coalescing and produced delayed ACKs and intermittent chunk delivery stalls. Marissa scaled the pool and applied a temporary keepalive tweak; Jonas rolled back the offending parameter in the canary group and we’ve pushed the safe rollback to the regional pool.

Remediation & next steps:
- Completed: rollback of tcp_nodelay and safe restart of proxies (May 22, 11:30 PDT).
- Completed: short-term scaling and keepalive adjustment to reduce immediate impact.
- In progress: postmortem (owners: Jonas, Marissa) with runbook changes for config rollout and mandatory smoke tests. Target: 2028-06-02.
- Business: we will issue a goodwill credit for the incident window. Marissa and I will coordinate the sizing and notify you by EOD Friday.

If you want a quick sync with our infra leads, we can hop on a 20-minute bridge.

Sincerely,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
